extras: Desktop only (macOS Dock hiding is specific).
intentEvidence: Useful when Obsidian is doing background work (sync, automations, plugins that watch the vault) and you don't want it taking up the Dock or window switcher.
motivation: Useful when Obsidian is doing background work (sync, automations, plugins that watch the vault) and you don't want it taking up the Dock or window switcher.
problem: Users need a way to run Obsidian processes, like syncing or automations, without cluttering the operating system's window switcher or Dock.
summary: Headless Mode hides all Obsidian windows and the Dock icon, allowing the application to run silently in the system tray for background tasks.
